calls.bash: q() { mu sql "$1"; }; q "SELECT t.local_id, t.impact, a.name FROM tasks t JOIN agents a ON a.id = t.owner_id JOIN workstreams w ON w.id = t.workstream_id WHERE w.name = 'eval' AND t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY t.impact DESC" | head -5
annotate() { mu task note "$1" -w eval - ; }; printf 'top owner: %s\n' w2 | annotate s4
